summary.text: Leader of the Danaans whom Hector slew in the same onrush in which he struck down Asaeus, Autonous, and Dolops son of Clytius — no homonym in the atlas.

story.text: When Zeus vouchsafed Hector glory, the prince smote Asaeus first and Autonous, and Opites and Dolops son of Clytius, and Opheltius, and Agelaus, and Aesymnus, and Orus, and Hipponous — leaders of the Danaans, staunch in fight — and thereafter fell upon the multitude.
